genre_target: IELTS Task 1 含未来预测年份的图表 / 产业算力与能耗预测报告
domain_context: 长序列 Transformer 稀疏注意力与分块表征
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想处理同时包含过去历史数据（如 2010–2025）和未来预测数据（如 2026–2040）的图表段落，严格区分过去实测时态与未来审慎预测表达。
prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 1】假设你正在撰写【IELTS Task 1 含未来预测年份的图表 / 产业算力与能耗预测报告】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想处理同时包含过去历史数据（如 2010–2025）和未来预测数据（如 2026–2040）的图表段落，严格区分过去实测时态与未来审慎预测表达。”。请严格按照 `BP30` 的逐句功能骨架（4 步法）与逻辑法则 `L030`（成段后七维自检清单（The 7-Point Paragraph Audit Checklist）），写出一段 4–5 句、零 AI 痕迹、主语紧凑（≤6词）的自然英文段落。
source_material_or_draft: From 2010 to 2025, demand increased from 200 to 460. In 2035, it will increase to 1050. AI was 10% in 2023 and will be 45% in 2040.
structural_constraints: S1 [历史实测轨迹 Historical Trajectory (Past Tense)]：Between [2010] and [2025], global data-center electricity demand rose steadily from [200 TWh] to [460 TWh], driven by cloud migration.
S2 [当下转折与未来加速 Projected Acceleration (Projection Verbs)]：From [2026] onward, consumption is projected to accelerate sharply, with forecasts indicating a surge to [1,050 TWh] by [2035].

S3 [结构占比重塑 Structural Shift in Projections]：Within this projected expansion, generative AI training and inference—which accounted for less than [10%] in [2023]—are anticipated to represent over [45%] of total load by [2040].
S4 [条件式审慎收尾 Conditional Hedging]：Nevertheless, energy-efficient hardware adoption is expected to moderate the growth slope during the final five years.
target_defects_to_fix: 机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: 学术演讲图表/架构讲解逐字稿（Visual Walkthrough）
domain_context: 六级/雅思大作文：AI 自动化、教育与科研伦理

prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 2】假设你正在撰写【学术演讲图表/架构讲解逐字稿（Visual Walkthrough）】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想在演讲到架构图或核心实验曲线（Slide 4 / Slide 7）时，用最自然的口语引导听众的眼睛先看哪、再看哪，瞬间读懂图表背后的胜出逻辑。”。请按 `BP42` 的句子角色分工，先列出每句的主语核心词与谓语强动词，再连缀成完整段落。

S3 [引导观察我方稳定曲线 Guide to Our Curve]：Now compare that with our solid blue curve at the bottom, which stays flat even out to 720 steps.
S4 [一句话点破视觉差距原因 One-Sentence Takeaway]：That gap comes directly from our neural-ODE scale tracker preventing long-range drift.

genre_target: TOEFL Integrated Writing 主体段 / 论文理论争议辨析段
domain_context: 基于扩散/流匹配的缺失时序插补与生成
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写托福综合写作（Integrated Writing）或文献争议交锋段：先用 1 句话精准概括阅读材料（或正方文献）的分论点，再用 2–3 句话详细呈现教授讲座（或反方实证）是如何釜底抽薪推翻该论点的。
prompt_zh: 【深度病段修改诊所 3：专治口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）】下方议论/分析段落使用了烂大街的万能模板句且缺乏具象实例支撑。请砍掉全部套话外壳，并运用 `L021`（一句话具象行业微观案例法）重写该段。
source_material_or_draft: Time series imputation is very important in the era of big data. Existing generative models delve into the data distribution but are too slow and fail when missing rates are high. We propose FlowImp, a novel framework that uses conditional flow matching and frequency guidance. Extensive experiments show that FlowImp achieves state-of-the-art results on all benchmarks.
structural_constraints: S1 [正方/阅读论点概括 Reading Claim & Rationale]：The reading passage contends that [Claim A], arguing that [Reading's Supporting Mechanism].
S2 [反方/听力直接反驳 Lecture Direct Refutation]：The lecturer directly challenges this assertion by pointing out that [Core Flaw / Neglected Factor in Reading's Premise].
S3 [反方具体反证展开 Empirical Counter-Evidence]：Specifically, she explains that when [Real-World Condition], [Mechanism B occurs instead], which [Negates the Claimed Benefit].
S4 [结论锁定 Refutation Closure]：Consequently, rather than achieving [Reading's Goal], the proposed measure actually exacerbates [Negative Outcome].
target_defects_to_fix: 口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）

genre_target: IELTS Task 1 含未来预测年份的图表 / 产业算力与能耗预测报告
domain_context: 长序列 Transformer 稀疏注意力与分块表征
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想处理同时包含过去历史数据（如 2010–2025）和未来预测数据（如 2026–2040）的图表段落，严格区分过去实测时态与未来审慎预测表达。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：AI_Mini_Paper 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT06 (面向高维传感器网络的稀疏相位图注意力完整小论文（PhaseGraph: Scalable Spatio-Temporal Forecasting）)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP08 -> BP01 -> BP09`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: From 2010 to 2025, demand increased from 200 to 460. In 2035, it will increase to 1050. AI was 10% in 2023 and will be 45% in 2040.
structural_constraints: S1 [历史实测轨迹 Historical Trajectory (Past Tense)]：Between [2010] and [2025], global data-center electricity demand rose steadily from [200 TWh] to [460 TWh], driven by cloud migration.
S2 [当下转折与未来加速 Projected Acceleration (Projection Verbs)]：From [2026] onward, consumption is projected to accelerate sharply, with forecasts indicating a surge to [1,050 TWh] by [2035].

S3 [结构占比重塑 Structural Shift in Projections]：Within this projected expansion, generative AI training and inference—which accounted for less than [10%] in [2023]—are anticipated to represent over [45%] of total load by [2040].
S4 [条件式审慎收尾 Conditional Hedging]：Nevertheless, energy-efficient hardware adoption is expected to moderate the growth slope during the final five years.
target_defects_to_fix: 机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）

genre_target: TOEFL Integrated Writing 主体段 / 论文理论争议辨析段
domain_context: 基于扩散/流匹配的缺失时序插补与生成
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写托福综合写作（Integrated Writing）或文献争议交锋段：先用 1 句话精准概括阅读材料（或正方文献）的分论点，再用 2–3 句话详细呈现教授讲座（或反方实证）是如何釜底抽薪推翻该论点的。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP31` 与全文样板 `FT06` 的后半部分（`BP11 -> BP12 -> BP13`），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: Time series imputation is very important in the era of big data. Existing generative models delve into the data distribution but are too slow and fail when missing rates are high. We propose FlowImp, a novel framework that uses conditional flow matching and frequency guidance. Extensive experiments show that FlowImp achieves state-of-the-art results on all benchmarks.
structural_constraints: S1 [正方/阅读论点概括 Reading Claim & Rationale]：The reading passage contends that [Claim A], arguing that [Reading's Supporting Mechanism].
S2 [反方/听力直接反驳 Lecture Direct Refutation]：The lecturer directly challenges this assertion by pointing out that [Core Flaw / Neglected Factor in Reading's Premise].
S3 [反方具体反证展开 Empirical Counter-Evidence]：Specifically, she explains that when [Real-World Condition], [Mechanism B occurs instead], which [Negates the Claimed Benefit].
S4 [结论锁定 Refutation Closure]：Consequently, rather than achieving [Reading's Goal], the proposed measure actually exacerbates [Negative Outcome].
target_defects_to_fix: 口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
